requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Changed temperature/distance and repeated button edges
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: The display retains only the selected valid sensor value
requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
按钮（D2）切换显示：温度（DHT11）/距离（HC-SR04）
Disclosed bench completion for unspecified display/wiring: TM1637 CLK=D4,DIO=D5; DHT11 DATA=D7; HC-SR04 TRIG=D8,ECHO=D9; button D2 to GND, INPUT_PULLUP, active LOW. Each completed button cycle switches the displayed quantity. Display response within 250ms of a new available sensor value; sensor acquisition limits remain applicable.
